title: Trust, but verify the agents
subtitle: A week of arguments that code review can't keep up, and what replaces it
editor_note: Most of this week's saves circle one problem: agents now write code faster than people can read it. Lauren, the Claude Code team and Addy Osmani each answer it the same way, by moving trust out of human review and into the codebase, the tests and automated checks. Felix Rieseberg pushes from the other side, asking for bigger goals, and Jev shows models that reason with images.
